messages:
raj_customer: Hey team — tried to redeem the 14-day free trial + a referral voucher on my account earlier and it looks like the free trial credit got replaced by the referral credit. Current balance shows only the referral amount. Can you confirm if vouchers are meant to merge or overwrite? account: acct_8Gf... (redacted)

mike_support: Sorry about that, Raj. Can you share the exact steps you took to redeem both? also did you see any error or confirmation message in the UI? :eyes:

raj_customer: Steps: 1) Signed up via email 2) Clicked "Start free trial" (UI showed 50 USD trial credit) 3) Went to referral link immediately and clicked "Claim referral" 4) UI flashed "Referral applied" and then balance changed to 25 USD (referral). No error shown.

raj_customer: Quick repro curl I tried just now (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/redeem \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \ 
  -d '{"code":"FREE14"}'

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/redeem \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \ 
  -d '{"code":"REFERRAL25"}'
```
Response after second call: `{"status":"ok","applied":"REFERRAL25","credits":25}` — free trial no longer visible.

mike_support: Thanks — that helps. I'm going to escalate to billing to confirm intended behavior and whether we accidentally replaced the trial credit. @nicole_billing can you take a look? I'll attach invoice and the two redeem call IDs in the ticket. :raised_hands:

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-1234 for acct_8Gf... assigned to nicole_billing. Priority: high.

nicole_billing: Hi Raj (and Mike) — quick note: by product design some voucher types should stack (e.g., promotional credits + usage coupon) and others are single-instance (free trials are gated). That said, the UI should have shown an explanation. I'm pulling the ledger entries now. Can you confirm the email on the account so I pull the right records?

raj_customer: raj@startup.example — thanks. Also, this caused one of our cron jobs to hit a 402 while we were in the middle of onboarding (billing error when trying to create an invoice). Would prefer a fast fix — can you restore the trial if possible?

nicole_billing: Understood. I found the two redeem events. System logged `redeem_event.id=rv_98765` then `rv_98766` and the second event invoked the voucher resolution policy which evaluated available stacks and selected REFERRAL25 as the active voucher, replacing FREE14. That's why you saw 25 USD only. We're treating free trials as non-stackable by default. That behavior is intended but we need clearer UX.

nicole_billing: Workaround: I can manually credit the account with the remaining trial balance and mark it as an internal grant so it won't conflict. If you want exactly the original trial semantics (expiry and usage rules), I'll apply an internal adjustment labeled `trial-restore`. Confirm and I'll do it now.

raj_customer: Please apply the restore, we need the trial for the onboarding flow. Also can you whitelist our account for a short grace period so we don't get 402s while this is sorted?

mike_support: Adding the grace window now — applying a temporary hold so usage won't generate 402s for 1 hour. Nicole — if you apply the internal credit, please reply with the adjustment id so I can confirm in the console.

nicole_billing: Done. Applied internal grant: `adjust_2026_01_TRIALRESTORE` for $50, expiry in 14 days. Marked as internal=true and non-stackable=false (so it won't be auto-replaced). Adjustment id: ADJ-4492.

mike_support: Confirmed ADJ-4492 shows in billing ledger and balance updated to reflect both referral + restored trial (display shows 75 USD total for now). Raj, can you verify your UI and retry the failing job?

raj_customer: Verified — UI now shows 75 USD and the job ran successfully. Thanks for the quick turnaround. One request: can product add an inline helper about voucher stacking rules? I almost assumed they stack.

nicole_billing: Absolutely — I'll file a product follow-up to add tooltip copy and adjust the redeem flow to show "this will replace your free trial" when applicable. Filed issue: PRO-6673.

mike_support: Closing our immediate loop — leaving BILL-1234 open until UI copy lands. Raj, please reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

raj_customer: All good. Appreciate the fast help! :pray:
